prompt: Make a FigJam board with one titled section called "Apiary chores — March" holding a column of sticky notes: Check hive weights, Scrape burr comb, Replace mouse guards, Order new frames, Clean the smoker.

I need a comparison board with two titled sections side by side: "Cargo bike delivery" with sticky notes Low running cost, No parking fees and Limited to 40 kg, and "Electric van delivery" with sticky notes Carries pallets, All-weather and Needs depot charging.

Build a FigJam board titled "Community garden plot owners" with nine sticky notes arranged as a grid: Plot 1 Hana, Plot 2 Dmitri, Plot 3 Fatima, Plot 4 Owen, Plot 5 Priya, Plot 6 Lars, Plot 7 Noor, Plot 8 Tess, Plot 9 vacant.

Create a process flow for a sourdough bakery using predefined process shapes in order: Mix and autolyse, Bulk ferment, Shape loaves, Cold proof overnight, Bake in deck oven. Connect each step to the next with arrows.

Draw a decision flow for a lighthouse lamp check: a rounded rectangle "Run night test", then a diamond "Lamp lit?", with a branch labelled Yes to "Log as serviceable" and a branch labelled No to "Dispatch keeper".

A water treatment flow with the steps Intake screening, Coagulation, Sand filtration, Turbidity check and Release to mains, connected in order, plus a dashed connector from Turbidity check back to Coagulation labelled "Re-treat".

Make a board showing a pottery kiln firing: shapes Load kiln, Ramp to 1000C and Cool and unload connected in order, and give "Ramp to 1000C" a self-loop connector labelled "Hold 20 min, re-check cone".

Diagram a ticket barrier and its validator as two rounded rectangles, with two separate connectors running between them: one from Barrier to Validator labelled "Card presented" and one from Validator back to Barrier labelled "Open or reject".

Create a board with three squares — Quarry, Rail yard and Port terminal — connected Quarry to Rail yard to Port terminal, and make the Rail yard to Port terminal connector thick and labelled "Main aggregate line".

Make a small system diagram for a library catalogue: rounded rectangles "Search front end" and "Catalogue API", and a database shape "Holdings store". Connect Search front end to Catalogue API labelled "query" and Catalogue API to Holdings store labelled "SQL read", with arrowheads on both.

A FigJam board with a free text heading reading "Trail maintenance ideas — Ridgeway section" and beneath it a row of sticky notes: Rebuild the stile at gate 4, Cut back bramble near the spring, Add a waymarker at the fork, Re-gravel the boggy stretch.

Build a board for an orchestra seating plan: an invisible group holding three ellipses labelled First violins, Second violins and Violas arranged in a row, and below it another invisible group holding Cellos and Double basses in a row.

Make a three-page FigJam board for a rockpool survey. Page "Field notes" has sticky notes Tide was lower than forecast and Two new limpet species; page "Specimen list" has sticky notes Beadlet anemone, Shore crab and Snakelocks anemone; page "Next steps" has sticky notes Repeat at spring tide and Photograph the south gully.

Create a payroll run flow: a parallelogram "Import timesheets", then a predefined process "Calculate gross and deductions", then a document shape "Print payslips", then a document shape "File RTI submission", connected in that order with arrows.

Draw a flow for a radio station handover with an ellipse "Start of shift" at the beginning and an ellipse "End of shift" at the end, and between them the squares Check transmitter log, Load the playout queue and Brief the next presenter, all connected in sequence.

Make a board laying out a glacier survey in strict order: Set the GPS base station, Walk the ablation stake line, Record stake heights, Drill replacement stakes, Download the base station data. Each step should follow the one before it.

A FigJam board with one titled section "Signalling stages" containing rounded rectangles Track circuit occupied, Interlocking checks route, Signal cleared to green and Train passes signal, stacked in a column.

Build a board titled "Harbour festival jobs" with a row of three titled sections: "Before" with yellow sticky notes Book the brass band and Print the programme, "On the day" with green sticky notes Set up the stalls and Marshal the slipway, "After" with blue sticky notes Return the barriers and Send thank-you notes.

Make a decision flow for a bicycle puncture: square "Remove the wheel", diamond "Tyre holds air?", a branch labelled Yes to "Refit the wheel" and a branch labelled No to "Patch or replace the tube", then a connector from "Patch or replace the tube" to "Refit the wheel".

Cria um quadro FigJam em português de Angola sobre o piloto de gestão de filas numa unidade de saúde no Sumbe: uma secção "Missão" (IA responsável que protege direitos), uma secção "Âmbito do piloto" (registo de marcações, estado da fila, lembretes só com consentimento) e uma secção "Riscos e mitigação" (exposição de dados de saúde → encriptação; exclusão de quem não tem telemóvel → manter opção em papel). Liga a missão ao piloto com a etiqueta "orienta".

Haz un tablero FigJam de retrospectiva en español con tres secciones: "Qué salió bien" (Lanzamos a tiempo, Buena comunicación), "Qué mejorar" (Demasiadas reuniones, Pruebas inestables) y "Acciones" (Revisión semanal de métricas, Más tiempo para diseño).

Crée un tableau FigJam en français pour l’ordre du jour d’un atelier : une étape « Accueil et café », puis « Présentation des priorités », puis « Idées des équipes », puis « Décisions et prochaines étapes », reliées dans l’ordre avec des flèches.

Erstelle ein FigJam-Board auf Deutsch für einen Freigabeprozess: „Antrag einreichen“, dann eine Raute „Budget geprüft?“, bei Ja „Bestellung auslösen“, bei Nein „Rückfrage an Antragsteller“, die gestrichelt zurück zu „Antrag einreichen“ führt.

Create a clear, professional one-page FigJam project strategy board in Portuguese (Angola), titled “NEDA — Viabilidade e piloto inicial no Sumbe”. Use a clean institutional layout, readable Portuguese labels, grouped sections and labelled connectors. Do not invent numeric scores, budgets, partnerships, approvals, or measured results. Show the NEDA initiative as a proposed independent public-interest initiative, not a legally registered or endorsed institution. Include: (1) central goal: responsible AI that benefits people, protects rights and supports sustainable development, beginning in Sumbe, Angola; (2) first pilot recommendation: administrative appointment and queue management support in ONE health facility, with human staff retaining all decisions; appointment registration, queue status, reminders only if consent and channel available, simple operational reporting; no diagnosis, triage of clinical urgency, prescriptions, patient prioritization by AI, or autonomous clinical decisions; (3) critical dependency: obtain written authorization from the health facility and relevant health authorities, assess current workflow and existing systems, and ensure compatibility with Angola’s DHIS2 national health information ecosystem rather than creating a parallel system; (4) implementation stages connected in order: stakeholder consultation and baseline measurement; process mapping; legal/privacy/security review; prototype with minimal or synthetic data; staff training; limited pilot; independent evaluation; scale only after evidence and approval; (5) success indicators to measure before and after: waiting time, missed appointments, registration errors, staff time spent on administration, user satisfaction, system uptime, complaints and privacy/security incidents; do not pre-fill target values; (6) major risks and mitigations: no institutional access (do not start); health-data exposure (data minimization, role-based access, encryption, retention limits, incident plan, legal review); unreliable connectivity (offline/low-bandwidth fallback); staff resistance (co-design and training); duplicate systems (integrate or stop); exclusion of people without phones (retain walk-in and paper option); vendor lock-in and cost growth (open standards, portability, exit plan); AI errors (keep AI out of clinical decisions); (7) overall NEDA feasibility conditions: credible public value and policy alignment; originality must be demonstrated against existing initiatives; phased scope; multidisciplinary governance; transparent funding; independent audit; measurable outcomes; no claims of UNESCO/AU/MINSA partnership until formally agreed; (8) other NEDA domains as later phases, not simultaneous launches: education, connectivity, agriculture, environment, public services, telecoms; (9) governance guardrails: human oversight, rights, transparency, accountability, data protection, cybersecurity, accessibility, community participation. Connect the NEDA mission to the pilot, pilot to gates, and gates to measured scale decision. Use concise wording, distinguish confirmed facts from proposed actions, and make the board easy to understand.
